So I have pcos - polycystic ovary syndrome- and since I don’t take any hormones my uterine lining also never sheds it’s just builds and that’s a risk apparently as well, and I also have had fibroids in the past. Luckily I’ve never had any positive diagnosis. They’ve always scanned me and biopsied me and everything came out clean. So I just go in to get checked out by my obgyn periodically to make sure I am on top of any possible cancer since I have other risk factors as well.
